name: Wyvern Venom Gland
description: An intact poison reservoir harvested from the stinger barb of a wyvern.

name: Basilisk Eye
description: A crystalline petrifying ocular bulb carefully extracted from a slain basilisk.

name: Troll Blood Vial
description: Thick, sluggishly pulsating venous blood that coagulates rapidly in open air.

name: Cave Fisher Filament
description: Extremely tensile silk coated in sticky subterranean resin, harvested from subterranean arthropods.

name: Fire Beetle Luminescent Gland
description: A glowing abdominal gland that emits steady illumination for several days after harvesting.

name: Remorhaz Thermal Core
description: An intensely superheated internal furnace nodule extracted from an arctic predator.

name: Fresh Mandrake Root
description: A humanoid-shaped botanical root with mild narcotic and restorative alchemical properties.

name: Dire Wolf Winter Pelt
description: A thick, coarse pelt from a mature dire wolf, prized for rugged cold-weather garments.
